experience.title: Global Risk Intelligence and Technology Co-op
bullets: Recommended a prioritization framework for 80+ candidate automation use cases, ranking by effort-to-impact ratio to determine which initiatives the team built first, and designed a reusable AI agent capability architecture, breaking down business pain points (e.g., meeting-insights capture) into modular, shareable capabilities like transcript retrieval, extraction of dates/decisions/owners, and structured output formatting, that could be recombined across agents, cutting solution complexity by 75% across 20 capabilities.
Automated Excel-based workflows using Python (Pandas, OpenPyXL) across 56 files, saving 170-220 hours per week and eliminating repetitive manual effort.
Authored technical documentation and handover guides to reduce onboarding friction for future contributors.

experience.title: Data Analytics Intern - Northeastern/City of Toronto Research Partnership
bullets: Contributed to a Northeastern research team partnered with the City of Toronto's Transportation Services to analyze mobility patterns (TELUS Insights, 100K+ devices) for major recurring events (Pride Parade, Caribbean Carnival), findings were presented to the city's traffic management office and referenced in Northeastern's public research coverage.

Analyzed public-transit vs. highway usage by originating region (Durham, Halton, Peel, York) across three years to identify where transit adoption lagged, directly informing where the city could target public-transit awareness campaigns.
Built Python/SQL data pipelines and Power BI/Matplotlib/Plotly visualizations to communicate multi-year attendance and mode-share trends to a non-technical municipal audience.

projects.title: Bank Transaction Fraud Detection - End-to-End ML Pipeline
bullets: Built an end-to-end fraud classification pipeline (1M synthetic transactions, 17:1 class imbalance); weighed a SQL rule-based baseline (26.2% fraud capture) against ML approaches, selecting XGBoost with a 3-tier flagging system (28.5% capture at 11% flag rate) to balance fraud capture against customer friction.
Used SHAP to identify top fraud drivers and built a multi-page Power BI dashboard (KPI cards, tier-based slicers, feature-importance views) for risk-management style review.

projects.title: Toronto Island Ferry Sales Forecasting
bullets: Built an automated forecasting pipeline (Prophet, Airflow, DVC) and deployed a containerized app on AWS ECS/ECR with CI/CD; designed a Streamlit dashboard to visualize forecasted demand trends.
